findings.evidence: The conclusions/right-hand sides at lines 52–53, 73, 98–99, and 108–109 are equalities. Mathlib/Analysis/Distribution/TemperedDistribution.lean:404 names the adjacent analogue `lineDerivOp_toTemperedDistributionCLM_eq`; the naming addendum specifies `_eq` for equality statements.
findings.fix: Rename the family to include `_eq`, following `TemperedDistribution.lineDerivOp_toTemperedDistributionCLM_eq`; e.g. `…lineDerivOp_toTemperedDistribution_eq`, `…of_lineDerivOp_toTemperedDistribution_eq`, `…iff_lineDerivOp_toTemperedDistribution_eq`, and an analogous `…toTemperedDistribution_ofReal_eq` name.
findings.issue: All four bridge names at lines 50, 70, 95, and 105 omit `_eq` for the tempered-distribution equality; line 105 additionally omits `toTemperedDistribution`, making `lineDerivOp_ofReal` misdescribe the expression.

summary: The weak-derivative bridge family does not name its distribution equalities consistently with Mathlib or the TauCeti `_eq` convention.
